title: Importing Power BI and Tableau files with Genie Code will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled
body:
You can use Genie Code to import Power BI and Tableau files as AI/BI dashboards and metric views. Starting on or after December 15, 2026, this will be available by default for workspaces with the [compliance security profile](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile) enabled. Until then, a workspace admin can turn it on from **Previews** in the workspace settings.

Importing requires [partner-powered AI features](/aws/en/databricks-ai/partner-powered) for the account and workspace.

See [Import BI files using Genie Code](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/import-bi).
